title: fine-print's document model: validate, repair, fromArray, describe, lint, schema, guide

contract.summary: The agent-facing model functions, compared as values. Messages are contract: an agent reads them. PHP's empty object is [] (SPEC 4.2); guard:* lint rows need the reader and skip for the ports until phase R.

functions.guide: guide() -> {sha256} of the agent guide with CRLF -> LF

contract.referenceNote: Run on PHP 8.4 by the exporter.

notes: Rows are EXPORTED from PHP by fine-print/tests/Conformance/Export.php (composer conformance:export) and are never edited by hand or regenerated by a port. fine-print's DriftTest re-exports to a temporary directory and fails if anything here moved.

No discrimination probe for the writer itself lives here: the implementation under test is a PDF writer, which this package does not carry (the same known gap as flow/graph-runs). canon() IS small enough to carry: tests/fine-print-canon.test.ts re-implements it independently of the exporter, checks it against every writer-bytes artifact, and pins its mutants.
